lines.en: I drift over the floor; my feet don't touch it.

lines.zh: 我的影子在动，身体却不动。
lines.en: My shadow moves, but my body doesn't.
One step, and I'm closer to you.

lines.zh: 我的颜色发黄，像旧报纸。
lines.en: I'm yellowed like old newsprint.

lines.zh: 关节不响，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: My joints don't creak. No sound at all.
I cross the corridor, and no light comes on.
I don't need to look at the way.

lines.zh: 我的身体是空的，只剩一个念头。
lines.en: My body is hollow. Only one thought remains.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，温度会降。
lines.en: The temperature drops where I pass.

lines.zh: 一步跨出去，中间没有过程。
lines.en: One step, and there's no in-between.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，落下去时已经在别处。
lines.en: I lift a foot and set it down somewhere else.
I'm coming your way.

lines.zh: 我站着，眼睛是两个黑洞。
lines.en: I stand, my eyes two dark holes.

lines.zh: 我不出声，这里就安静得可怕。
lines.en: I make no sound, and the silence is awful.
I've been in this building a long time.

lines.zh: 有人在我耳边说话，其实没人。
lines.en: Someone whispers at my ear. There's no one.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，一直没正过来。
lines.en: My head is tilted and never rights itself.
I hover a finger's width off the floor.

lines.zh: 布下面的东西，不是机器。
lines.en: What's under the cloth isn't machinery.

lines.zh: 我不需要走路，我只是出现。
lines.en: I don't need to walk. I simply appear.

lines.zh: 我在等一个坐进椅子的人。
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone to sit in that chair.

lines.zh: 我坐着的时候，地板会陷下去。
lines.en: When I sit, the floor sinks.
I see you. I always could.
Don't turn around. It won't help.
My face is one step from yours.
Do you hear something?
The wall behind you is empty.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声，在这么静的地方很响。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud in a place this quiet.
I watch you from across the room.

lines.zh: 你已经在这儿了，不是吗。
lines.en: You're already here, aren't you.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没有光，可我在看。
lines.en: My eyes have no light, yet I'm watching.

lines.zh: 别喊，喊了也是这个结果。
lines.en: Don't scream. It ends the same either way.
You struck the shadow I left.
And yet I took half a step back.

lines.zh: 我不该在这里的，我知道。
lines.en: I shouldn't be here. I know.
The golden shell has faded.
My body is coming apart.
There's nothing beneath the cloth.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声，是我在叫。
lines.en: That sound you heard — it was me.
I was never whole.
One more and I disappear.
Scattering is fine. I should have long ago.

lines.zh: 金壳都旧了，还留什么吃的。
lines.en: My golden shell is worn; why keep food?
Such kindness. Rare.
I reach out. My hand is translucent.

lines.zh: 东西从我手里穿过去了。
lines.en: It passed through my hand.

lines.zh: 这味道，我早就不记得了。
lines.en: I stopped remembering that smell long ago.
Feeding me won't help.

lines.zh: 我接不住，可我还是伸手。
lines.en: I can't hold it, yet I still reach.
Keep your hand steady. I can reach it.
I won't touch the pizza you offer.
Set it down. I won't touch it.
You ran into me and passed through.
Where you touched me will turn cold.
We collide, and you fall.

lines.zh: 我不占地方，可你撞得到我。
lines.en: I take no space, yet you can hit me.

lines.zh: 我的身体不重，你的手却抬不动。
lines.en: My body is light, yet your hand won't lift.
We pass and the lights go out.

lines.zh: 碰一下，你就听见了那个声音。
lines.en: One touch and you'll hear that sound.
Don't face me head-on.
I don't need a path. You do.
Hit me and you won't get away.

lines.zh: 我没有可以给你的东西。
lines.en: I have nothing to give you.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，可我不介意。
lines.en: You're standing very close. I don't mind.
You can still look at this face.

lines.zh: 有人陪着，这栋楼就不空。
lines.en: With company, this building isn't empty.
I won't leave, and I won't keep you.
Sit here a while.
Leave at dawn. Don't look back.

lines.zh: 我记不住你的脸，但记得你来了。
lines.en: I won't recall your face, but I'll recall you came.

lines.zh: 这声音，是给你一个人听的。
lines.en: This sound is for you alone.
Close your eyes and it won't feel so cold.
I reach, and it falls through.
I can't touch solid things.
Keep your things yourself.
I can't move what's on the ground.

lines.zh: 我看着它，它就浮起来了。
lines.en: I look at it and it rises.
It hangs in the air, then drops.

lines.zh: 我拿不起来，只能让它动。
lines.en: I can't lift it, only make it move.
This thing is familiar.

lines.zh: 我的攻击力，是九千零一。
lines.en: My attack power is nine thousand one.
These aren't mine.

lines.zh: 你选了这条走廊，那就别回头。
lines.en: You chose this corridor — don't look back.
You chose this corridor.
I don't chase. I only need to be here.
You've run once already.
This time it won't be the same.

lines.zh: 我的脸，就是最后看见的东西。
lines.en: My face will be the last thing seen.
The light died. Did you hear it?

lines.zh: 你数到六的时候我动了。
lines.en: I moved when you counted six.
The chair is still there.
Come over this way.
I wait in this chair.
This building won't let you out.
Don't hide. I'm here.
There's no way behind you.
Now. Look at my face.

lines.zh: 你眨眼时我就换了地方。
lines.en: I change places when you blink.
I'm behind you. I always was.

lines.zh: 你跑得很快，可走廊很长。
lines.en: You run fast, but the corridor is long.
I'm behind every door.

lines.zh: 我站在你手电照不到处。
lines.en: I stand where your torch can't reach.
Try looking again.
Your footsteps echo.

lines.zh: 这个声音，是从你后面来的。
lines.en: That sound came from behind you.
You go left. I'm on the left too.
I'm already ahead of you.
The corridor lights are going out one by one.
You shouldn't have come this way.
On this floor, there's only us.
I need neither speed nor slowness.
The walls are receding.

lines.zh: 你已经在这里绕了很久。
lines.en: You've been circling here a long while.
Your torch is down to a yellow ring.
Listen. The music box stopped.
Now only my voice remains.
Don't shut your eyes. I'm not behind you.
Closing them won't help.

lines.zh: 我抬手的动作，你看不清。
lines.en: You can't see my hand rise.

lines.zh: 这一下不是力，是别的东西。
lines.en: This blow isn't force. It's something else.

lines.zh: 我的手从你身体里抽出。
lines.en: My hand pulls back out of your body.
A coldness in your chest.
I didn't touch you, and you fell.

lines.zh: 你没有受伤，可你站不起来。
lines.en: You're not wounded, yet you can't rise.
I said one thing at your ear.
You didn't catch it. No second chance.

lines.zh: 我的头歪下来，靠在你肩上。
lines.en: My head tilts onto your shoulder.
This one I gave you.
You have a little time left.
Your remaining time is used up.

lines.zh: 我不恨你，只想让你留下。
lines.en: I don't hate you. I want you to stay.
I only need you to stay.
This building needs someone to keep it company.
You already are.
Don't struggle. It passes quickly.
I'm holding you. Don't be afraid.
All the lights are out. Quiet now.
It's quiet now.
I appear at the end of the corridor.
No light came on, yet here I am.

lines.zh: 油漆的味道从墙里透出来。
lines.en: The smell of paint seeps from the walls.
My feet never touched the floor.
This building remembers me.
The poster on the wall changed faces.
The air turned cold.

lines.zh: 我坐过的那把椅子，空着。
lines.en: The chair I sat in is empty.
I've come, without a sound.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我就在那。
lines.en: When you look up, I'll be there.
I don't need a door.
Count to three and I'm there.

lines.zh: 火里，我的影子反而更清楚。
lines.en: In fire, my shape is clearer than ever.

lines.zh: 我坠落的时候，没有重量。
lines.en: Falling, I had no weight.

lines.zh: 水灌不进一个空的东西。
lines.en: Water can't fill an empty thing.
In the ring of blast, I stood.

lines.zh: 那东西穿过去，钉在墙上。
lines.en: It went through and stuck in the wall.

lines.zh: 这光让我显出来了一瞬。
lines.en: The light made me visible for a moment.

lines.zh: 我从来不饿，这让我害怕。
lines.en: I never hunger. That frightens me.
After the thunder, I was still there.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，连我也不像有了。
lines.en: Nothing here — not even me, quite.
